purpose: 确认通用工具与晓暖 v0.1 的手写流程等价，再交付给新的博主使用
inputs: 晓暖复刻工程的本地研究数据：12 条样本清单与哈希、Whisper 转写、全片测量与 OCR 统计；原片与转写不随本 Skill 分发

pack_rebuild.method: 把冻结包的 32 条规则与 219 条证据转成 media-cloner-draft/v1 草稿，用 cloner.py build 在原转写上重新定位全部引文
pack_rebuild.verify_with_transcripts: passed: every excerpt found in the preserved transcript, every start time on a segment boundary

measurements.media_two_train_samples: integrated LUFS, true peak, hard cuts, silence seconds and median segment identical to the original metrics
measurements.tone_scan: 1 kHz separator events identical for 10 of 10 training samples; holdout not scanned
measurements.layout_ocr_two_samples: title lines (including OCR misreads), title persistence, subtitle coverage, characters per line and subtitle top identical
measurements.training_metrics: 8 distributions within 0.01 of the original (duration, Han chars per minute, first tone, LUFS, true peak, silence fraction, cuts per minute, median segment)

template.method: generic template with the 晓暖 tokens versus her dedicated template, same timeline, frames 100 / 320 / 600 / 1500
template.pixel_difference: mean 0, max 0 on all four frames

audio.method: build_audio.py with the demo structure: voice 0–10.3 s, 0.77 s 1 kHz tone, voice 12.67–74.1 s
audio.result: -15.71 LUFS, -4.28 dBTP; original -15.7 LUFS, -4.5 dBTP; correlation 0.9998 at zero lag

also_verified: lov-laozhang-style-media-creator v0.1 pack passes cloner.py verify (23 rules, 157 evidence)
not_claimed: a new creator analysed end to end with this Skill
